title: Lawton Community Theatre
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Are you searching for a community where you can just be yourself? Perhaps you're looking for a local performing arts theatre where you can catch a show during the week. Whether you're a performer or a theatre enthusiast, Lawton Community Theatre in Lawton, OK is the place for you. We're proud to be the longest-running community theatre in Oklahoma.
